```{r setup, include=FALSE}
metadata <- read.delim("data/metadata/mehreen_metadata_fixed.txt",
                       check.names = FALSE)
metadata <- metadata[, !is.na(names(metadata)) & nzchar(names(metadata)),
                     drop = FALSE]
metadata$Diet <- factor(metadata$Diet, levels = c("33", "50", "83"))
metadata$Treatment <- factor(metadata$Treatment, levels = c("Control", "Infected"))

counts <- read.csv("data/raw_read_counts/master_counts_no_rRNA.csv",
                   check.names = FALSE)
```

```{r hero, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat('

```

```{r metrics, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
n_samples <- nrow(metadata)
n_genes <- nrow(counts)
diet_levels <- paste(levels(droplevels(metadata$Diet)), collapse = " / ")
treatment_levels <- paste(levels(droplevels(metadata$Treatment)), collapse = " / ")

cat('<div class="metric-grid">')
cat(sprintf('<div class="metric"><span>%s</span><strong>samples</strong></div>', n_samples))
cat(sprintf('<div class="metric"><span>%s</span><strong>counted genes</strong></div>',
            format(n_genes, big.mark = ",")))
cat(sprintf('<div class="metric"><span>%s</span><strong>diet levels</strong></div>', diet_levels))
cat(sprintf('<div class="metric"><span>%s</span><strong>treatments</strong></div>', treatment_levels))
cat('</div>')
```

## How To Read This Site

<div class="note-panel">
<p>
The website now has one recommended path rather than a flat list of every page.
Use <strong>Fat Body Experiment</strong> for the primary DESeq2 results and
sample-filter/outlier sensitivity scenarios. Use <strong>Interpretation</strong>
for candidate genes, GO/KEGG, and publication panels. Use
<strong>Reference Context</strong> only after the experiment DEGs have been
defined, to ask whether fat body DEGs also overlap tissue or phase signatures.
Older exploratory pages remain under
<strong>Archive</strong> for provenance, but they are no longer the main route
through the analysis.
</p>
</div>

## Recommended Reading Path

<div class="analysis-grid">
  <a class="analysis-tile" href="01-study-design-data.html">
    <span>Step 1</span>
    <strong>Study Design and Data</strong>

  </a>
  <a class="analysis-tile" href="02-workflow-reproducibility.html">
    <span>Step 2</span>
    <strong>RNA-seq Workflow</strong>
    <p>Document how reads move from trimming, STAR alignment, and featureCounts into the count matrix.</p>
  </a>
  <a class="analysis-tile" href="03-count-qc-exploration.html">
    <span>Step 3</span>
    <strong>Fat Body Count QC</strong>
    <p>Check library sizes, PCA structure, sample distances, and broad expression quality.</p>
  </a>
  <a class="analysis-tile featured-tile" href="16-all-samples-infection-within-diet-deg.html">
    <span>Step 4</span>
    <strong>Fat Body Infection DEGs</strong>
    <p>Define infected-versus-control DEGs within each diet using all fat body samples.</p>
  </a>
  <a class="analysis-tile" href="14-all-samples-deseq2-interaction-model.html">
    <span>Step 5</span>
    <strong>Diet x Infection Model</strong>
    <p>Check the formal full-model terms for diet, treatment, and their interaction.</p>
  </a>
  <a class="analysis-tile" href="19-outliers-removed-infection-within-diet-deg.html">
    <span>Step 6</span>
    <strong>Outlier-Removed DEGs</strong>
    <p>Repeat the key fat body DEG views after removing the current outlier set.</p>
  </a>
  <a class="analysis-tile" href="13-physiology-candidate-genes.html">
    <span>Step 7</span>
    <strong>Candidate Genes</strong>
    <p>Focus on insect-relevant immune, energy-store, amino-acid, nutrition, and stress genes.</p>
  </a>
  <a class="analysis-tile" href="10-go-term-enrichment.html">
    <span>Step 8</span>
    <strong>GO and KEGG Enrichment</strong>
    <p>Review eggNOG-derived enrichment after understanding the DEG foregrounds.</p>
  </a>
  <a class="analysis-tile" href="25-enrichment-term-gene-index.html">
    <span>Step 9</span>
    <strong>Term-to-Gene Index</strong>
    <p>Search which DEG IDs contributed to each enriched GO term or KEGG pathway.</p>
  </a>
  <a class="analysis-tile" href="22-deg-logical-set-construction.html">
    <span>Step 10</span>
    <strong>Reference Context</strong>
    <p>Ask whether fat body DEGs are shared with tissue-reference, head-phase, or thorax-phase signatures.</p>
  </a>
  <a class="analysis-tile" href="08-publication-figures.html">
    <span>Step 11</span>
    <strong>Publication Figure Exports</strong>
    <p>Find rendered panels that can be assembled or refined for manuscripts and collaborator slides.</p>
  </a>
</div>
